name: techne
description: Code-repo skills: toolchain audits, CI log review, adversarial pre-merge review, commit planning, GitHub catch-up, cross-repo drift, slop cleanup, and doc/code drift.

clean_finished_work.title: Clean up finished work at session start
clean_finished_work.description: When a session starts or resumes, remove worktrees and branches whose PR merged and that nothing is using, and list what a merge left behind.

resume_brief.title: Brief each session on the branch's work
resume_brief.description: When a session starts, resumes, clears or compacts in a repo that keeps an IMPL.md, add the branch's IMPL.md, its commits past the default branch, its uncommitted files and its push state as context. Local git only.
